subject.title: fix(ai): preserve compat xhigh reasoning effort

question: Which active PR should be the single canonical landing path for OpenAI-compatible `xhigh` reasoning effort after exact-head proof is supplied?
rationale: The current branch explicitly rebases the earlier open implementation but adds later hardening, and the supplied proof does not cover its final head; choosing the lasting review and ownership path is a maintainer decision.

options.title: Adopt this rebased successor
options.body: Require exact-head redacted request proof and a live compatible-provider check on `c090e71`, then use this branch as the canonical implementation.

options.title: Consolidate into the earlier PR
options.body: Port only the verified unique registry or boundary hardening into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90703 and continue review there.

options.title: Pause both branches
options.body: Hold the overlapping work until an owner confirms the durable provider compatibility contract and desired canonical branch.

recommendation.title: Adopt this rebased successor
recommendation.body: Require exact-head redacted request proof and a live compatible-provider check on `c090e71`, then use this branch as the canonical implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The available feature history identifies Alex-Govorov as the original implementation contributor most familiar with the compatibility contract.
